Synopsis:
    BoE Governor Bailey addressed parliament's Treasury Committee, explaining that market interest rate curves reflect an investor-added inflation risk premium tied to energy price concerns — beyond what BoE policy expectations alone would justify. Bailey also pushed back against the narrative that a rate hike is inevitable, stressing that future policy moves remain conditional on economic developments and that no predetermined path exists.
